bio: Housed in a century-old building set slightly back from the coastal road that runs along the Adriatic, in the warmer months the restaurant welcomes guests with a pleasant shaded outdoor area looking across to the island of Krk. The interiors are warm and welcoming, centred around an attractive dining room with a fireplace. The kitchen offers rich and colourful dishes built around numerous ingredients and inspired by local specialities, reinterpreted with contemporary taste and careful presentation. Some rooms are also available.
